lci.text: Breeches goes with his friend Malcolm into the empty Downtown, where they follow the tracks of the missing residents ever downward and find a trail of abandoned tools leading into a tunnel.

In a fungus-lit cavern, a fungus-ridden raptor corpse attacks, and when spores begin to turn the crew, Malcolm and Breeches cut the elevator cables and send the infected pirates falling into the dark, leaving the two of them the only survivors of the party.

Deeper down they meet the Mycotyrant, which wants the sun above and means to assimilate them, so Malcolm sings to stun the colony and they flee, bursting out above the River Heralds' city and heading through the golden door to warn the Core.

In the Core, Breeches pulls out the flowery tube weapon he got in High and Dry and fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray, and he later destroys the Mycotyrant's nexus body, though both the god and its hive mind escape.
